events.title: DEMO 1.0.2
events.summary: DEMO UPDATE 1.0.2 is now available!While I continue working on the full game, I’m also adding improvements and fixes to the DEMO. A new monster is now available. I call him Astroman. He will play an important role in the story. New gameplay elements have also been added.Download the DEMO here:I’d also be very happy if you joined my Discord server and shared your thoughts about the game. I’m active there and can listen to your feedback: https://discord.gg/gDNqWgrS56

events.title: CO-OP DEMO
events.summary: Dear friends, after releasing the first DEMO, I noticed that quite a lot of players jumped in right away. The DEMO is a one-hour single-player story experience. I decided to expand the DEMO and open up the co-op mode for you. I’ve released an update where you can now test CO-OP. Welcome!You can download the DEMO here:I’d also be very happy if you joined my Discord server and shared your thoughts about the game. I’m active there and will be able to listen to your feedback: https://discord.gg/gDNq

events.title: DEMO IS LIVE!
events.summary: Dust Vein is still in development, but it’s already time to release the DEMO. I’m developing the game solo, so I have to keep a huge number of details in mind. In this DEMO, I focused on introducing players to the atmosphere of the game. It’s a one-hour single-player run in which you play as one of the clones who survived the crash of an elevator.You can already play the DEMO by finding it on the game’s Steam page, or simply by using this link:
